svg.aria-label: The first 100 zeta zeros, sent by w = 1 - 1/rho, lie exactly on the unit circle with their conjugates, all within a short arc near w = 1; a schematic off-line zero would land off the circle in a pair w and 1 over w-bar
svg.text: ● unit circle |w| = 1, the image of Re ρ = 1/2
● w = 1 − 1/ρ for the first 100 zeros and their conjugates
○ dashed: where a schematic off-line zero (0.85 + 2.5i, not a real zero) would land: w, conj(w), 1/w, 1/conj(w)
all 200 points sit on the arc (|θ| < 0.075)
